column1: # Named column-projection views (MDD 11.3) with row windows.
# One set per platform, because the client and the server are separate relations.
# Measured on this book (sheetty pack): an unwindowed evidence sheet is far larger
# than any single context window. re/methods costs ~379,526 estimated tokens
# unwindowed, 1.9x a 200k window on its own, so a whole evidence sheet is not a
# usable context unit - MDD open question Q6. The MDD's prescribed fix is a row
# window rather than a smaller sheet, "because splitting the sheet would break the
# key space". That is what `row_window` is: `*` for all rows, or `A..B` inclusive.
# A budget is what I am willing to spend; a window is what makes that possible.
